title: Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Trip Charge — Zone Fees and Calculation
content:
*Patient Billing fee schedule note — Specimen Collection Appointments.*

**Calculation clause.** The trip charge for a collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit is the published trip fee of the zone band the visit was booked in, taken at a dispatch notice rate of 1.00, and it is posted as one assessed trip fee rounded to the cent.

| Zone band the visit was booked in (service zone on the visit record) | Distance from the dispatching Patient Service Center | Published trip fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Service zone 1 | Up to 10 road miles | 75.00 |
| Service zone 2 | Over 10 to 25 road miles | 95.00 |
| Service zone 3 | Over 25 to 40 road miles | 125.00 |

**Formation of the charge.** The figures that enter the trip charge combine in one fixed order: the band fee of the trip is taken first; any amount added to the trip is added to the band fee; that sum is multiplied by the dispatch notice rate; any credit on the trip is subtracted from that product. The trip charge never goes below 0.00, and it is rounded to the cent only once, at the end, never at an intermediate figure.

**Medicare homebound certification.** No trip charge is assessed at all when the patient's Medicare homebound certification is on file for the visit — the visit record shows the homebound status "Medicare homebound certified" — because the collection and travel are billed to Medicare.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Visit | Band fee | Multiplied by 1.00 | Trip charge posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Booked in service zone 1, no homebound certification | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 |
| Booked in service zone 2, no homebound certification | 95.00 | 95.00 | 95.00 |
| Booked in service zone 3, no homebound certification | 125.00 | 125.00 | 125.00 |
| Booked in service zone 3, Medicare homebound certified | — | — | No trip charge |

## Points of judgement

- **Which zone?** The zone band is the service zone recorded on the visit when it was booked; the fee is read from the table above for that zone.
- **When is the figure rounded?** Once, on the final figure; a figure such as 95.004 reached at the end is posted as 95.00.
- **Can the charge be negative?** No; the trip charge never goes below 0.00.
